mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `company_blacklist` (`company_id`, `user_id`, `operator_id`, `reason`, `created_at`) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{userId}, #{operatorId}, #{reason}, NOW()) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `operator_id` = new.`operator_id`, `reason` = new.`reason`
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `company_blacklist` WHERE `company_id` = #{companyId} ORDER BY `created_at` DESC
